QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: usbRadioPort
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Radio streaming its channels over USB with an EdgeTX script
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: A radio running the Aircast USB radio script (aircast-usb.lua) streams its channels over USB serial. On the radio: SYS → Hardware → USB-VCP set to LUA; plug in and choose USB Serial (VCP); then SYS → Tools → Aircast USB. While it streams, its channels 1 to 18 fly the active vehicle as RC overrides. Off sends nothing.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Radio on USB (EdgeTX script)

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: usbRadioStandby
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Network standby (4G / Starlink): the radio flies over its own link, and the aircraft's network link takes over with its channels if that link drops
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The radio's channels go to the aircraft's computer instead of the flight controller. While the radio's own link flies the aircraft they are held back; if that link fades or the flight controller reports a radio failsafe, the aircraft's computer flies these channels over its network link (4G, Starlink or any IP link) until the radio's link is good again. ArduPilot multicopters with aircastd only.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Network standby (4G / Starlink)

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: usbRadioPitchChannel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Camera pitch channel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The radio channel that tilts the camera: its lowest value points straight down, its highest straight ahead. The radio's script sets an empty channel up for it. 0 turns it off.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Camera pitch channel

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: usbRadioYawChannel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Camera yaw channel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The radio channel that turns the camera across the gimbal's yaw limits. The radio's script sets an empty channel up for it. 0 turns it off.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Camera yaw channel

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: usbRadioZoomChannel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Camera zoom channel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The radio channel that sets the camera's zoom level, from wide at its lowest to full zoom at its highest. The radio's script sets an empty channel up for it. 0 turns it off.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Camera zoom channel

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: usbRadioPictureChannel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Camera picture channel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: A three-position switch: visible, the camera's own picture, thermal. The radio's script sets an empty channel up for it. 0 turns it off.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Camera picture channel

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: usbRadioPaletteChannel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Thermal palette channel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: A momentary switch: each press steps to the next thermal palette. The radio's script sets an empty channel up for it. 0 turns it off.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Thermal palette channel

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: usbRadioDropChannel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Payload drop channel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Flipping it up drops the payload, once the drop is armed. It has to read up on two lines in a row. The radio's script sets an empty channel up for it. 0 turns it off.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Payload drop channel

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: usbRadioArmChannel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Payload arm channel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: High arms the payload drop; the middle and low positions keep it safe. The radio's script sets an empty channel up for it. 0 turns it off.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Payload arm channel

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: usbRadioBayChannel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Payload bay channel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: A six-position switch picking the bay the drop releases. The radio's script sets an empty channel up for it. 0 turns it off.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Payload bay channel

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: usbRadioTiltChannel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Tilt knob channel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: A knob that tilts the camera from straight down to straight ahead, like the camera pitch slider. The radio's script sets an empty channel up for it. 0 turns it off.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Tilt knob channel

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: usbRadioLookChannel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Look switch channel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: A three-position switch: up looks straight down, down looks ahead, the middle leaves the camera where it is. The radio's script sets an empty channel up for it. 0 turns it off.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Look switch channel
